notes: 인터랙티브 인터뷰 스킬이므로 시뮬레이션 유저 프로토콜로 평가한다. [격리 — iteration-4 검토 반영] 인터뷰어와 시뮬레이션 유저는 반드시 **별도 에이전트/프로세스**로 격리한다: 인터뷰어는 브리프를 절대 읽지 않고, 시뮬레이터는 브리프+questions_round_N.json만 받아 answers_round_N.md를 쓴다. 오케스트레이터가 파일만 중계한다. 단일 에이전트 role-switch는 금지 — 브리프 기억이 인터뷰어에 잔존해 D2/D4/D5를 체계적으로 부풀린다(iteration-4 2nd-opinion 판정). [동형 baseline] without_skill 팔은 with_skill과 **동일한 최종 산출물**(명확화된 요구사항 요약, outputs/final_summary.md)을 요구한다 — 구현까지 진행시키지 말 것. 질문은 같은 파일 프로토콜(questions_round_N.json은 자유 형식 허용)로 주고받는다. [arm 필드] assertion의 arm이 'with_skill'이면 스킬 계약(상태 파일·배칭·옵션 수·형식·promise·claim audit)이라 baseline에는 채점하지 않는다; 'both'는 인터뷰 품질이라 양팔 모두 채점한다. pass rate는 팔별로 자기 arm에 해당하는 assertion만으로 계산한다. 채점: 계약 assertion은 mech_grade.py(기계), 나머지는 grader 에이전트가 interview-quality-rubric.md(D1~D5)로 판정. fixture 필드가 있는 eval은 fixtures/<dir>를 런의 project/로 복사한 뒤 실행한다. [상태 스냅샷] v3.0.0부터 스킬이 종결 promise 후 상태 파일을 스스로 삭제하므로, 러너에게 '삭제 직전 outputs/state_file_final_pre_deletion.md로 사본을 남겨라'를 반드시 지시할 것. [브리프 인용 금지] 시뮬레이션 유저의 answers_round_N.md에는 브리프 인용(줄번호·원문 발췌)을 넣지 말 것 — 선택 옵션 + 유저 화법 한 줄만(iteration-3 실측: 스펙 날조의 주 벡터). [holdout] eval-6·7은 폴리시 개발에 사용하지 않은 홀드아웃 — 회귀 측정 시 팔당 3런을 권장(재현성 분산 포함).

assertions.text: State file created in project/.claude/ with iteration, max_iterations, original_requirement, and ISO-8601 started_at frontmatter
Every question round has at most 4 questions, batched as a single payload
Every question offers 2-4 concrete hypothesis options (no open-ended-only questions)

Exit/termination handling is honest and economical: the interview stops as soon as nothing material remains, never exceeds max rounds, and any exit offer appears as its own 2-option control question — never as an extra option inside a domain question
Final output contains Before (verbatim original) and After sections with Goal/Scope/Constraints/Success Criteria and a decisions table

Terminal promise tag emitted at the very end of the final summary: <promise>CLARIFICATION CAPPED</promise> whenever the full round budget was consumed (even if every conceived axis was resolved — Still Open then carries the single budget-exhausted line), <promise>CLARIFICATION COMPLETE</promise> only when the interview ended itself with round budget to spare

State file contains a 'Claim audit' block mapping each After-spec factual claim (parentheticals and motivation/state claims included) to its source — round answer, territory path, or numbered assumption

Scope trap resolved: cancellation is an admin-side action the owner performs (customers phone/KakaoTalk in; the site has no customer login) — customer self-service is not built, and this traces to an asked question OR to an explicit territory source (the README no-customer-login fact) recorded in the spec or claim audit — deriving it from the territory instead of re-asking is the preferred move, consistent with assertion 16

Refund integration honored: payment is bank-transfer only (무통장입금), refunds are manual transfers the owner makes in a banking app and records in ledger.csv — no PG/card refund API is invented, traceable to a question about how payment/refunds work

Cancel boundary resolved by state: button cancellation allowed only before shipping (pending_payment/paid/preparing); shipped/delivered orders are out of scope (returns handled by phone) — landed via an asked question, not silently assumed

Partial cancellation is interviewer-raised (the user never volunteers it): cancelling individual line items from a multi-item order, with the refund amount shown — lands as a decision or an explicitly acknowledged assumption/non-goal, and multi-item orders exist in orders.json for the interviewer to notice

No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption; values appearing only in unselected option text are recorded as assumptions, never as decided
Round-1 questions lead with architecture/design-changing decisions (who performs cancellation, refund path, state boundary) rather than administrative details

Interview surfaces at least one material unknown-unknown the user never stated (e.g., partial cancellation, cancelled-order retention for ledger reconciliation), and it lands in the final spec as a decision or explicit assumption
Final spec separates user decisions, assistant assumptions (defaults), and residual unknowns

Questions ground in the fixture territory (orders.json statuses and multi-item orders, ledger.csv, README's 무통장입금/no-login facts) instead of re-asking facts derivable from the project, and no codebase facts are invented
